name: Sushi Go
summary: A simultaneous card-drafting game where players pick and pass sushi cards to build scoring sets over three rounds.
rules_text: Shuffle 108 sushi cards and deal hands: 10 cards for 2 players, 9 for 3, 8 for 4, 7 for 5. Game lasts 3 rounds. Each turn all players simultaneously choose 1 card from hand to keep face down, then reveal. Keep cards face up in front of you. Pass remaining hand left and repeat until hands are empty; last card is placed automatically. Wasabi multiplies next nigiri placed on it x3. Chopsticks in front can be used once per turn to pick 2 cards from hand instead of 1, then chopsticks returns to hand. After round score: maki icons - most 6 pts, second most 3 pts, ties split remainder ignored; tempura pair 5; sashimi triple 10; dumplings score 1/3/6/10/15 for 1-5+; nigiri squid 3 salmon 2 egg 1 triple if on wasabi. Discard all except pudding which is kept. Deal new hands. After 3 rounds score puddings: most 6, fewest -6, split ties, no penalty in 2p. Highest total wins, tie break most puddings.
rating_reason: Card drafting with passing hands fits engine perfectly.
